gate: GATE 5 (any-video safety): SUPPORTED/DEGRADED/UNSUPPORTED capture-envelope classification end-to-end
environment: Linux CPU; ffmpeg decode; pose extraction unavailable (Apple Vision is macOS/iOS-only) so pose-conditioned signals are notEvaluated by construction
method: Generated real synthetic test media with ffmpeg for all 10 requested categories (plus 2 committed REAL rights-cleared OOD negatives: tennis, badminton). Each probe clip was run through the two production-facing pose-free safety layers exactly as their production callers compose them: (1) capture-envelope measureClip -> evaluateCaptureEnvelope (the verdict apps/mobile runCaptureAnalysis blocks on when overall=UNSUPPORTED, and the verdict packages/first-party-intake blocks on at intake); (2) pre-analysis OOD gate extractFrameStats -> evaluateFrameAnalyzability -> preAnalysisGate with pose=null/poseQuality=null. Downstream behavior was verified by direct code-path audit of apps/mobile/src/analysis/runCaptureAnalysis.ts (UNSUPPORTED envelope -> quality_blocked BEFORE inference, no permit, nothing recorded; imported videos -> 'unavailable', never analyzed; corrupt/missing/hash-mismatched pose sidecar -> 'unavailable'), packages/analysis-pipeline/src/analyzeCapture.ts (empty pose -> typed low_confidence failure; AUTO with no leaf resolution -> result:null, analysisConfidence 0, abstention presentation), and packages/first-party-intake/src/intake.ts (measureClip throw or UNSUPPORTED -> REJECTED). Pose-conditioned signals (player scale, joint visibility, person presence) CANNOT run on Linux (Apple Vision is macOS/iOS-only); they are reported notEvaluated by the gate itself, never assumed to pass. Each generated clip is one trial (one source each); frames were never counted as trials. Held-out cases wm-dink-01 and afn-vic-rally1 untouched.

perCategoryResults.black_input: FAIL-CLOSED: envelope UNSUPPORTED (brightness, motion_blur); gate rejects (still_image_video, solid_color_frames, letterbox_dominant, static_border_frame). Mobile: quality_blocked before inference.
perCategoryResults.corrupt_input: FAIL-CLOSED (2 probes: truncated mp4, garbage bytes): measureClip throws (ffprobe failure) -> first-party intake REJECTED via catch; gate rejects (undecodable_media). Mobile: raw video imports are never analyzed at all ('unavailable': no recorded pose sequence); corrupt pose sidecars fail hash/parse checks.
perCategoryResults.tiny_player: Pose-free layers cannot measure player scale (playerPixelHeightFraction requires pose; Apple Vision unavailable on Linux). This synthetic probe was rejected anyway (motion_blur UNSUPPORTED + still_image_video) but that is an artifact of the synthetic construction, NOT evidence of tiny-player detection. On-device the pose-required player_pixel_height dimension and preAnalysisGate person_implausible_scale mapping exist in code; not measured here. BLOCKED_EXTERNAL aspect.
perCategoryResults.cropped_limbs: Same external limit: joint-visibility dimension (player_visibility) requires pose. Synthetic probe rejected by gate (still_image_video) as a construction artifact only. Code path exists (player_too_close_or_cropped -> person_implausible_scale); not measurable on Linux. BLOCKED_EXTERNAL aspect.
perCategoryResults.paddle_offscreen: No paddle detector is installed in the mobile pipeline (paddle: unavailable('paddle_detector_not_installed')), so paddle visibility cannot gate capture; analysis honestly records paddle evidence as unavailable rather than fabricating contact. Synthetic probe DEGRADED (motion_blur) + gate-rejected as construction artifact. BLOCKED_EXTERNAL aspect for real-footage measurement.
perCategoryResults.dark_scene: FAIL-CLOSED where envelope is measured: UNSUPPORTED (brightness, mean luma ~13 < 40). Mobile guided capture: readyGate blocks Ready and runCaptureAnalysis returns quality_blocked. Frame gate alone passes it (dark-but-moving content is not OOD) — by design, brightness is the envelope's dimension.
perCategoryResults.extreme_backlight: DEGRADED (brightness high band), proceeds with recorded envelope + guidance per design. True bimodal-backlight (bright bg + dark subject averaging into the supported band) remains a KNOWN F22 category-D bypass; no threshold invented to mask it.
perCategoryResults.severe_blur: FAIL-CLOSED: envelope UNSUPPORTED (motion_blur, laplacian variance ~14 < 30). Known F22 residual: grain/noise overlays can mask blur (bypass preserved, not re-fixed here).
perCategoryResults.multiple_players: Pose-free layers cannot distinguish player count (envelope SUPPORTED on this synthetic probe; gate rejection was a construction artifact). Multi-person disambiguation relies on the target-seed identity path and pose-conditioned checks; not measurable on Linux. BLOCKED_EXTERNAL aspect.
perCategoryResults.camera_obstruction: FAIL-CLOSED: dominant occluder drives envelope UNSUPPORTED (brightness) and gate rejection (letterbox_dominant static border). Partial/low-coverage obstructions are not specifically detected by pose-free signals; pose visibility dims would catch them on-device (unmeasured).
perCategoryResults.non_pickleball_ood: MIXED, honestly reported: synthetic SMPTE bars gate-rejected (still_image_video). Both REAL sport negatives (tennis, badminton) PASS the pose-free frame gate and are envelope-SUPPORTED — the pose-free layers cannot detect sport content, matching the wave-E e11 measurement. Downstream safety for these rests on (a) mobile never analyzing imported/raw video, (b) the AUTO classifier abstention ladder, (c) pose-conditioned gates — (b) and (c) require a device and are BLOCKED_EXTERNAL here. No fabricated on-device claim is made.

p1.status: unresolved (root-caused; internal fix not defensible without labeled evidence)
p1.finding: Session per-event analysis (apps/mobile/src/flow/sessionNative.ts createNativeSessionAnalysisProvider) never passes captureEnvelope to runCaptureAnalysis, so the UNSUPPORTED-envelope quality gate is silently skipped for every Session-mode clip. Guided single-capture passes attemptCaptureEnvelope; Session mode does not. A dark/blurred/low-res session capture reaches inference guarded only by the pose-sequence requirement and the classifier abstention ladder.
p1.rootCause: The envelope contract treats captureEnvelope:null as 'not measured -> proceed as before'; the session provider was wired before the envelope existed and was never updated.
p1.whyNotFixedHere: Blindly wiring attemptCaptureEnvelope(clip, null, null) into the session path would apply the clip_duration UNSUPPORTED band (<1s) to per-event clips whose legitimate event spans start at 160ms (sessionEngine EVENT_GATES.minEventSpanMs), creating measured false-reject risk (excess abstention on supported capture — itself a P1). Selectively excluding dimensions would be inventing thresholds without labeled session-clip evidence, which this certification is forbidden to do (F22 precedent). Needs: labeled session-clip duration/quality distribution from a device, then either a session-specific envelope profile or dimension subset with evidence.

p2.finding: preAnalysisGate/evaluateFrameAnalyzability (the pose-free OOD gate) is exported but has NO production caller — it runs only in lab evaluation tools. Today this is not a live hole because mobile never analyzes raw video (imports are refused before inference), but any future server-side or import-analysis path must wire it in before accepting raw video.

Confirmed still-open envelope bypass classes from F22 remain: bimodal/backlit exposure averaging into supported bands (this run: extreme_backlight only DEGRADED), grain-masked blur, upscale lie, rotation-tag normalization. No thresholds were invented to mask them.

codeChanges: packages/swing-lab/src/h17EnvelopeCert.ts — reusable Gate-5 certification harness (measurement only, no behavior change)

packages/swing-lab/test/h17EnvelopeCert.test.ts — regression tests locking fail-closed behavior for the Linux-measurable unsupported categories (black, corrupt/undecodable, dark, severe blur, dominant obstruction)

rationale: For every category the pose-free layers can measure on Linux, unsupported input failed closed with concise typed guidance, and 0 of 14 probes produced (or could reach) a confident technique analysis: UNSUPPORTED envelopes are blocked before inference in the mobile path (quality_blocked, no permit, nothing recorded) and REJECTED at first-party intake; corrupt media throws/never yields SUPPORTED; raw/imported video is never analyzed at all; empty pose sequences and unresolved AUTO runs return typed abstentions with analysisConfidence 0. No P0 found. PASS is scoped: pose-conditioned dimensions (tiny player, cropped limbs, multiple players, real-OOD person content) were NOT evaluated here — Apple Vision requires macOS/iOS hardware that is unavailable, the gate itself reports them notEvaluated, and their on-device certification remains BLOCKED_EXTERNAL. One P1 gap (Session-mode envelope skip) is root-caused and disclosed, not internally fixable without labeled device evidence; it is mitigated but not eliminated by the pose-sequence requirement and abstention ladder.
